target_customer: Operators of pipelines, power transmission lines, highways, rail and construction sites that need geospatial survey data
problem: Collecting survey and inspection data over long linear assets is slow and costly with crewed aircraft and short range drones. Colony builds long range autonomous VTOL aircraft that collect geospatial data at scale.
business_model: Data collection as a service and aircraft platform, details not stated; likely usage or contract based
product_category: Long range autonomous drones for geospatial data

founders.name: Rad El Gharbi
education: Harvard particle physics and cosmology lab from age 17
founders.background_notes: Particle physicist researching dark matter and neutrino experiments, and an infantryman, per YC.

founders.name: Igor Martins
founders.background_notes: Member of the Waterloo Rocketry Design Team, from Brazil.

competitors.name: Voltair
competitors.what: Globally distributed network of autonomous long range drones recharging on utility poles, for Earth observation

competitors.name: Rift
competitors.what: Paris based long range real time aerial intelligence network for borders and infrastructure
competitors.funding_then: 4.6M EUR raised in November 2025 led by AlleyCorp

competitors.name: Exabotix
competitors.what: Drone port paired with the SWIFT VTOL, flying up to 120 km per flight for linear infrastructure inspection

technical_complexity.rationale: A long endurance autonomous VTOL aircraft with 500 km range, multi sensor payloads and onboard AI requires hardware, aerodynamics, avionics and aviation regulatory approval for beyond visual line of sight flight, all from a three person team.

defensibility.rationale: Aircraft design and flight approvals are hard to copy, but several funded rivals attack the same long range wedge and the product claims are company reported.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too early to judge. Other drone network operators were already raising money in 2025 and 2026.

market_need_then: Pipeline, grid, rail and highway operators need frequent geospatial surveys; regulators have been opening beyond visual line of sight operations, and drone in a box vendors were selling into utilities in 2026.

branding.domain_note: Uses colony.tech, not colony.com; the corporate name is Colony Dynamics Inc.

identity.voice_and_tone: Technical; tagline Geospatial data at scale

branding.brand_signature: The Trinity aircraft and the Autonomous Colony tagline

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself was found; the name Colony fits a swarm or network concept but is a common word.

outcome_analysis: Colony is a Winter 2027 company so no outcome exists yet. It pairs a physicist CEO and an aircraft building CTO from Waterloo with a hardware heavy product in a market where funded rivals already operate long range drone networks. The main risks are capital intensity and aviation approvals, but nothing has happened to confirm either.
notes: No press, funding or brand coverage of Colony was found in four searches, so funding is none_found rather than zero. The batch is Winter 2027, so competitor sources are dated 2025 to 2026. Exabotix and Voltair dates are loose. Founder claims are from the YC page only.
